questions.q: A brownfield site is land that...
options: has been built on before and is now derelict or unused
is protected as a national park
questions.why: Brownfield sites were previously developed; greenfield sites have never been built on.

questions.q: Which is a reason for developing a brownfield site?
options: it protects farmland because existing roads and utilities are there
questions.why: Brownfield sites reuse existing infrastructure and protect the countryside; contamination is a disadvantage.

questions.q: Which strategy best describes a self-help housing scheme?
options: the government builds all the homes
homes are demolished and residents removed
residents build or improve their own homes with materials and support
questions.why: Self-help schemes give materials and services while residents do the building.

questions.q: For a named city, explain one way transport has been improved to make the city more sustainable.
questions.model: Curitiba introduced bus rapid transit with dedicated lanes and fast boarding, so more people use buses instead of cars and congestion and pollution fall.
